review_description: The sales and quotes process was great they asked all the right questions to deliver us the best system our home needed. The install was very neat and tidy, they went above any beyond to get our system installed in the duration they were in our area. And the guys were great to talk to and weren’t bothered answering questions about the process. Costomer service has been fantastic from start to finish it’s nice to actually talk to the owner of the company instead of a sales person they organised everything very quickly and hassle free. We highly recommend Big Sky Energy

I had the rep come out I told him I was looking at a 10 as I did not want any more bills he advised me that I only needed a 6.9 and should not get any bills if so only very little. He showed me on paper what system would make each month so I too his word and went with his advice. Well 12 months later I am still getting bills and the system has never ever made what he quoted me on paper after making several complaints to the owner stating I did not get what the rep promised he said he would sell me another system to add to existing one at cost price as you would expect I’m not at all happy with that and can’t afford another system. Quote you a price and what it will make and if it does not make what was quoted they will pay the difference. I have given them numerous chances to rectify this problem now he won’t even get back to me so I am seeking legal action as I paid a lot of money and was guaranteed i would have no or very little bill this is certainly not the case very unhappy customer

Sales pitch was good.  Handed over to Natasha, as soon as finance approved and date organised, didnt really hear from her again.Installation was quick.  However, they wanted to know where to put the inverter, we asked them whatever is the best place.  All they said was is cant be near the Meter box.I was told initially that our systems will be installed by Big Sky, but found out it was installed by another installation company.The process after installation was just "Sign here" and that was it.  A booklet and serial stickers were left in meter box.  The Booklet was for the Fronius system that was not in English.We werent told to wait for Energex and retailer to let us know when its ready to go.  We had to look online for the English version of the manual to figure out how to connect to Fronius system using Wifi.  I called Big Sky and assume that I spoke to the owner who had no idea what to tell me over the phone.  He said he will call back, but never did.  Eventually I figured out how to use the System.  About a month later I was emailed a 'Customer Pack' which consisted of a partial picture of the Electrical Contractors details (Thanks Freedom Electrical and  Energy Solutions for installing our Solar).  Also consisted pictures of the Solar Specs, some Warranty information.   Very poor on Big Sky's part in regards to looking after Customers.
